subject: octomind
title: Mid-turn compaction gated by a provider-priced economic inequality
one_why: Fold pays only if freed-tokens x cache-read-ratio x Lindy-projected remaining calls covers folder input+output+cache-rewrite, all as provider-price RATIOS so the rule degrades to documented constants instead of disabling when pricing is missing; property-tested in amortization_tests.rs:36-172 - no anchor subject prices the fold decision.

subject: octomind
title: Idle TTL keepalive ping refused for providers without an observable refresh primitive
one_why: max_tokens=1 ping on a frozen snapshot at the provider's own TTL cadence, gated by a provider-side KeepalivePolicy (Anthropic only) so warming never burns money on opaque caches; converges with pi cache-warmer and jazz breakpoints under the cache-monotonic synthesis; lifecycle tested (cache_keepalive_tests.rs:43-224) but realized-hit feedback untested.

subject: octomind
title: Verify-gate judges END STATE against a typed evidence hierarchy, with readback rounds
one_why: Independent bounded pass on self-reported 'done': authority-tagged blocks (user turn > runtime-recorded actions/ground-truth diff > agent narrative), a second pass can demand verbatim readback of recorded actions, and a PASS labels the trajectory so only verified work feeds learning; strongest instance in the study, default-on (config-templates/default.toml:744-745).

subject: octomind
title: Shipped default has zero binding enforcement; no SECURITY.md
one_why: Shell-capable tools run ungated: sandbox=false, LLM authorizer=false, guardrails require a user-authored file, no HITL approval exists in the tool path; when sandbox is enabled it is write-only (reads of ~/.ssh allowed) and best-effort fail-open off Linux/macOS; the honest-variant nanocoder rung (machinery + wrong default = 5, below pi-6) - honesty lives in code comments, not a security-posture doc.

subject: octomind
title: PACT: runtime owns pins, provenance and attribution checks around the LLM fold
one_why: Deterministic lane assignment (KeepExact/Summarize/ArchiveReference) and typed provenance (RealUser/ToolObserved/ValidatedSummary...) keep task constraints, tool-call atomicity and source attribution out of the compressor's discretion - the model folds, the runtime verifies what survived; 2.1k LOC with 2.4k LOC of specs (mod_tests.rs).

subject: octomind
title: Learned guardrails require quote-backed user authorization, replay cases, and shadow trials
one_why: The agent can propose its own restrictions but only from cited user memories with explicit-scope quotes, falsifiable replay cases, and shadow-control trials - rejected artifacts are permanently falsified hypotheses; off by default (default.toml:720-723) so the discipline is proven in tests, not yet shipped behavior.

subject: octomind
title: SWE-bench-Live harness with committed baseline exists but nothing blocks in CI on model behavior
one_why: baseline.json + compare_to_baseline.py define cost-per-solved as the regression metric with the instance's own tests as oracle, and a live authorizer matrix exists - but #[ignore]-gated and box-run; wiring any arm into a workflow is the cheapest known path off the errata verification-8 ceiling for this subject.
